AI Hedge Fund Collapses After Leveraged Bets Fail

Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, is reportedly unwinding its operations. The fund managed up to $24 billion. This collapse follows leveraged bets on artificial intelligence that reportedly failed. The situation has also impacted earnings for major tech giants.
